body:
While working in progressively senior levels of responsibility at universities and international environmental organizations I had unique opportunity to serve various clients, ranging from governmental institutions, academia, non-governmental organizations and business.

Do you need guidance from a professional? Contact me today and explore how I can serve your needs.

items.name: Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA)
items.body: While working in the Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe I had the unique opportunity to cooperate with Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA), headquarter in Stockholm; Sweden, on various programmes: supporting environmental civil society organizations, equipping local communities with powerful tools and skills for environmental action planning, water management and local water security action planning, etc.

items.name: European Centre for Nature Conservation (ECNC)
items.body: With European Centre for Nature Conservation (ECNC), headquarter in Tilburg, Netherlands, I’ve worked on development methodology for local biodiversity action planning. Communities that used methodology become champions of change for sustainability in beneficiary countries and the region, providing an opportunity for other communities to replicate their work and ecosystem services experience, including combating effects of climate change. Note: ECNC ceased operations in 2017.

items.name: Emisoft
items.body: For several years I’ve worked with Emisoft to establish the Environmental Management Centres (EMC) in Balkan countries. In Serbia, our work resulted in setting up an efficient emission monitoring and reporting platform within Serbian Agency for Environmental Protection (SEPA).

items.name: GIZ
items.body: My professional network also includes Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ). Within the GIZ-commissioned project Development of Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans for Selected Local Self-government Units in the Western Balkans, I led the country expert team Serbia supporting the preparation of Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans (SECAPs), coordinating expert contributions to local energy and climate action planning.
